title: Annotation on an Earth-observation layer
description: One statement about what a layer shows or misses at a place. The register is mandatory: a statement never travels without saying what kind of statement it is.

register.description: measured: an instrument reading. interpreted: a reading of the data by someone. situated: what people in the place saw or said. speculated: a guess nobody has tested.

about.description: The layer or product the statement refers to.

place.description: A name people use for the place. A string, or one text per language code.

lngLat.description: Optional. Leave it out when the place must not be pinned; precision is decided by whoever owns the knowledge.

date.description: Date of what is described (ISO 8601), not of the annotation.

statement.description: The statement, keyed by language code.

review.description: Who checked the statement and against what. 'nobody yet' is a valid answer and must be shown. When the person who checked it is also its only source, write 'nobody independent yet'.

enum: public by decision of the owners
visibility.description: Who may see it. Community knowledge is never 'public source'. Only 'public source' and 'public by decision of the owners' may be stored in a public repository; 'shared with named groups' describes a record kept in a tool its owners control, and 'withdrawn' leaves an id with no statement.

decided_by.description: For community knowledge: the body that decided the visibility, and when.
